items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR after imaging and specialist consults; consensus is week-to-week. He is out this week vs Seahawks but aiming to return ASAP.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts; McLaurin retains some value but tough SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and residual WR targets.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip/groin) not making great progress; multiple DNPs this week and may miss Sunday vs DEN. McVay cautious, no long-term concern but availability doubtful.
items.implication: Davante Adams elevated to clear WR1 with high target/route share.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) very much in doubt / expected out vs IND after DNPs all week; Grade 1 but no practice return.
items.why: Continued DNP; no progress since Week 2 miss.
items.implication: Dalton Schultz sees elevated 28-30% target/route share.

items.text: Packers WR routes without Jayden Reed (neck/back): Christian Watson 45, Matthew Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson & Golden combined 48% of Love targets so far.
items.why: First game sans Reed; high route shares.
items.implication: Watson/Golden clear top options; more 2-TE possible but WRs cooking if OL holds.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets (8% share). Targets/route: 33% with London off, 17% with London on.
items.why: Low route participation and share when London active.
items.implication: Pitts limited unless London out or Penix revives both; London primary.

items.text: 49ers DE Nick Bosa pulled calf in Thursday practice; expected to miss a few weeks including Sunday vs ARI. Leaning against IR due to roster spots.
items.implication: 49ers DL further depleted (multiple injuries); run game implications for CMC.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP again Thursday; may miss second straight game vs DAL in Brazil. Worked on side but not practicing.
items.why: Second DNP; travel to Brazil complicates.
items.implication: Bateman and others absorb targets; Ravens pass game muted.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (core); only 5 games in 3 seasons. Chuba Hubbard firmly lead (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% team target share last week sans Collins; IND allows 4th-most TE yards. Also 30% routes targeted.
items.why: Elevated usage + matchup with Collins out.

items.text: Week 3 snaps & pace: CAR@CLE up-tempo; MIN@TB slow slogs. Thorman rankings and full report live. TNF focus on Penix-London/Pitts, Lloyd role, Reed absence.
Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs) and Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ share; WR9 PPG since Wk11 last yr).
Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest WR FP allowed, 7.9 ypr; WAS lowest implied total) and Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara).
After Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but Stevenson still ranked ahead Wk3; pass pro trust issue.
